extracted.intended_audience: librarians, educators, researchers, students, and readers interested in children's and young adult book awards (especially the Printz Award)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance describing the Michael L. Printz Award's evaluative standard: the award is given to a book that exemplifies literary excellence in young adult literature. The page also lists past winners and honor books as exemplars.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literary excellence in young adult literature
rubrics_metrics.description: The Michael L. Printz Award is an award for a book that exemplifies literary excellence in young adult literature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The statement is the core evaluative standard; the award is presented to a single book judged to exemplify literary excellence in the YA category. The award is named for a Topeka, Kansas school librarian and is sponsored by Booklist (a publication of the American Library Association). The page provides lists of past winners and honor books as exemplars of this standard.
